common.whyTransactional: You are receiving this email because of activity on your account.
common.whyNotification: You are receiving this email because you follow this in {orgName}.

created.subject: {actorName} mentioned you on {title}
created.body: {actorName} mentioned you in a comment on {title}.

assigned.subject: New shift: {title}
assigned.body: You are scheduled for {title} starting {startsAt, date, full} at {startsAt, time, short}.

changed.subject: Shift changed: {title}
changed.body: Your shift {title} now starts {startsAt, date, full} at {startsAt, time, short}.

requested.subject: {orgName} asks for your availability: {title}
requested.body: {orgName} asks which days you can work on {projectName}: {dayCount, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} from {firstDay} to {lastDay}. Your answers are shared with its planners.

submitted.subject: Invoice received: {title}
submitted.body: {actorName} received your invoice {title}. Follow it in Gateway under Money, Invoices.

scheduled.subject: Payment scheduled: {title}
scheduled.body: {actorName} scheduled a payment for your invoice {title}.

reported.subject: Incident reported: {title}
reported.body: {actorName} reported {title}. Open it to see the details and response.

security_changed.subject: Your account security changed
security_changed.body: {change, select, password {Your password was changed.} password_set {A password was added to your account.} password_removed {The password was removed from your account.} email {The email address you sign in with was changed.} phone {The phone number on your account was changed.} factor_added {{factorType, select, totp {An authenticator app} webauthn {A security key or passkey} phone {A phone} other {A second factor}} was added to your two-step verification.} factor_removed {{factorType, select, totp {An authenticator app} webauthn {A security key or passkey} phone {A phone} other {A second factor}} was removed from your two-step verification.} passkey_added {A passkey was added to your account.} passkey_removed {A passkey was removed from your account.} recovery_codes {A new set of recovery codes was made, and your old codes no longer work.} other {A security setting on your account changed.}} If this was not you, reset your password now.

recovery_code_used.subject: A recovery code was used on your account
recovery_code_used.body: Someone signed in or confirmed an action with one of your recovery codes. {remaining, plural, =0 {You have no codes left: make a new set in Security.} one {You have # code left.} other {You have # codes left.}} If this was not you, change your password and make new codes now.

session_signed_out.subject: {count, plural, one {A session was signed out} other {# sessions were signed out}}
session_signed_out.body: {count, plural, one {A session on your account was signed out} other {# sessions on your account were signed out}} from Settings, Security. If this was not you, change your password and check your sessions.

finished.subject: {stage, select, validated {Import ready to review: {title}} other {Import finished: {title}}}
finished.body: {stage, select, validated {{title} is checked: {written, plural, one {# row is} other {# rows are}} ready to write, {refused, plural, one {# needs} other {# need}} fixing and {skipped, plural, one {# was} other {# were}} skipped. Review it, then commit the import.} other {{title} finished: {written, plural, one {# row written} other {# rows written}}, {refused, plural, one {# refused} other {# refused}} and {skipped, plural, one {# skipped} other {# skipped}}.}}

ready.subject: Export ready: {title}
ready.body: The export {title} is ready to download.

payment_failed.subject: Your payment did not go through
payment_failed.body: We could not collect your subscription payment {days, plural, =0 {today} one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}. Update your payment method to keep full access.

read_only.subject: Your organization is read-only
read_only.body: Your payment is overdue, so your organization is read-only until the payment method is updated. No data has been deleted.

trial_ending.subject: Your Pro trial ends {days, plural, one {tomorrow} other {in # days}}
trial_ending.body: Add a card in Billing and plan to keep Pro. Your card is charged only when the trial ends. Without one, the organization moves to the Access plan: Pro features such as white label and custom domains stop, and no data is deleted.

trial_ended.subject: Your Pro trial has ended
trial_ended.body: Your organization is now on the Access plan. No data was deleted. Add a card in Billing and plan whenever you want Pro back.

received.subject: New message from {actorName}
received.body: {actorName} sent you a message. Open XOS to read and reply.

invited.subject: You are invited: {title}
invited.body: {actorName} invited you to {title} on {startsAt, date, full} at {startsAt, time, short}.

assigned.subject: Help request: {title}
assigned.body: A help desk request needs your team: {title}.

threshold.subject: {title} is at {percent}% of its permitted load
threshold.body: {title} has {count} people inside, {percent}% of the permitted load of {permitted_load}.

alert.subject: Weather alert: {level}
alert.body: A {hazard} reading of {reading} met the {level} threshold. Follow the emergency plan.

break_glass_started.subject: Emergency access taken in {orgName}
break_glass_started.body: {actorName} took emergency full access to {orgName} for one hour. Reason: {reason}

matched.subject: {count, plural, one {New match for {searchName}: {title}} other {# new matches for {searchName}}}
matched.body: {count, plural, one {{orgName} published {title}, which matches your saved search {searchName}.} other {{orgName} published # opportunities that match your saved search {searchName}, including {title}.}}

item_expiring.subject: {title} expires {days, plural, =0 {today} one {in # day} other {in # days}}
item_expiring.body: Your {title} for {orgName} expires on {expiresOn}. Renew it before then to keep your onboarding complete.

expiring.subject: Your {title} certification expires {days, plural, =0 {today} one {in # day} other {in # days}}
expiring.body: Your {title} certification expires on {expiresOn}. Renew it and update your profile so organizations see it is current.

expiring.subject: {kind, select, passport {Your passport} insurance {Your {title} insurance certificate} other {{title}}} expires {days, plural, =0 {today} one {in # day} other {in # days}}
expiring.body: {kind, select, passport {Your passport expires on {expiresOn}. Renew it before you travel for work.} insurance {Your {title} certificate of insurance on file with {orgName} expires on {expiresOn}. Send the renewed certificate before then.} other {{title} for {orgName} expires on {expiresOn}. Check whether it needs renewing.}}

deletion_requested.subject: Your organization will be deleted
deletion_requested.body: An Owner asked to delete the organization. It is read-only now and is deleted after {recover_until, date, long}. Until then, any Owner can recover it in Settings, Danger zone.

deletion_recovered.subject: Your organization was recovered
deletion_recovered.body: An Owner recovered the organization, so it will not be deleted. It can be used again.

ownership_offered.subject: {actorName} offered you ownership of the organization
ownership_offered.body: Open the organization in Atlas to accept or decline before {expires_at, date, long}. Accepting asks for your second factor.

ownership_accepted.subject: Ownership of the organization was accepted
ownership_accepted.body: {actorName} accepted your offer and is now the Owner.

ownership_declined.subject: Your ownership offer was declined
ownership_declined.body: {actorName} declined to become the Owner. You are still the Owner.

white_label_reverting.subject: White label ends on {until, date, long}
white_label_reverting.body: The plan no longer includes white label. Your brand without the XOS name and your custom domains stay until {until, date, long}, the end of the period you paid for. Then the default branding returns.

white_label_reverted.subject: White label has ended
white_label_reverted.body: The plan no longer includes white label, so the default branding is back and custom domains no longer show your brand. Move to Pro or above to bring it back.

client_left.subject: {org} left your partner account
client_left.body: {org} is now a direct customer. Your support sessions and standing grants for it have ended, and it no longer appears on your wholesale statements.

paused.subject: Automation paused: {automationName}
paused.body: {automationName} is off because {reason, select, owner_left_org {{ownerName} is no longer a member} owner_lost_capability {{ownerName} can no longer manage automations} owner_cannot_sign_in {{ownerName} has no sign-in} other {the API refused to act as {ownerName}}}. Turn it on again in Settings, Automations, and it runs as you.

moderated.subject: {action, select, Removed {We removed your listing {title}} Restricted {We restricted your listing {title}} Restored {We restored your listing {title}} other {We reviewed your listing {title}}}
moderated.body: {action, select, Removed {{statement} You can appeal this decision within six months from Opportunities, Marketplace settings in Atlas.} Restricted {{statement} You can appeal this decision within six months from Opportunities, Marketplace settings in Atlas.} other {{statement}}}

decided.subject: We reviewed the listing {title} you reported
decided.body: {action, select, Removed {We removed the listing.} Restricted {We restricted the listing.} Restored {We restored the listing.} other {We took no action on the listing.}} {statement} You can appeal this decision within six months.

decided.subject: {outcome, select, Reversed {We reversed our decision on {title}} other {We kept our decision on {title}}}
decided.body: {outcome, select, Reversed {Another reviewer agreed with your appeal and reversed the decision.} other {Another reviewer looked at your appeal and kept the decision.}} {statement}

filed.subject: {subject, select, comment {A comment was reported} message {A message was reported} other {A post was reported}}
filed.body: Someone reported a {subject, select, comment {comment} message {message} other {post}} for {reason, select, harassment {harassment or bullying} hate {hate speech or symbols} sexual_content {sexual content} violence {violence or threats} spam {spam or a scam} other {something else}}. Review it within 24 hours in Atlas, People, Reported Content.

overdue.subject: A reported {subject, select, comment {comment} message {message} other {post}} has waited more than 24 hours
overdue.body: A {subject, select, comment {comment} message {message} other {post}} reported more than 24 hours ago still waits for a decision. Review it in Atlas, People, Reported Content.

decided.subject: {action, select, Removed {The {subject, select, comment {comment} message {message} other {post}} you reported was removed} other {Your report was reviewed}}
decided.body: Your organization's moderators reviewed the {subject, select, comment {comment} message {message} other {post}} you reported. {statement}

removed.subject: {subject, select, comment {Your comment was removed} message {Your message was removed} other {Your post was removed}}
removed.body: Your organization's moderators removed your {subject, select, comment {comment} message {message} other {post}} under {ruleReference}. {statement}

digest.subject: {count, plural, one {# update} other {# updates}} from {orgName}
digest.heading: Your {frequency, select, weekly {weekly} other {daily}} summary
digest.intro: Here is what happened in {orgName} since your last summary.

invite.subject: {inviterName} invited you to join {orgName}
invite.heading: Join {orgName} on XOS
invite.expires: This invitation expires on {expiresAt, date, long}. If you were not expecting it, ignore this email.

report_delivery.subject: {reportName}: {periodLabel}
report_delivery.heading: {reportName}
report_delivery.body: Your scheduled report for {periodLabel} is attached as {format}.
report_delivery.membersOnly: Scheduled reports go only to members of {orgName}.

export_ready.subject: Your export {exportName} is ready
export_ready.heading: Export ready
export_ready.body: {exportName} is ready to download until {expiresAt, date, long}.

import_finished.subject: {stage, select, validated {Import {importName} is ready to review} other {Import {importName} finished}}
import_finished.heading: {stage, select, validated {Import ready to review} other {Import finished}}
import_finished.body: {stage, select, validated {{written, plural, one {# row is} other {# rows are}} ready to write, {refused, plural, one {# needs} other {# need}} fixing and {skipped, plural, one {# was} other {# were}} skipped. Review the rows, then commit the import.} other {{written, plural, one {# row written} other {# rows written}}, {refused, plural, one {# refused} other {# refused}} and {skipped, plural, one {# skipped} other {# skipped}}.}}

dsar_received.subject: We received your {requestType} request
dsar_received.heading: Request received
dsar_received.body: {orgName} received your {requestType} request on {receivedAt, date, long} and will respond by {dueAt, date, long}.

subprocessor_confirm.subject: Confirm your subscription to XOS subprocessor changes
subprocessor_confirm.heading: Confirm your subscription
subprocessor_confirm.body: You asked to hear about changes to the XOS Subprocessor List. Confirm within 7 days to start receiving notices.
subprocessor_confirm.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email and nothing will be sent.

subprocessor_notice.subject: XOS Subprocessor List changes on {effectiveOn, date, long}
subprocessor_notice.heading: Subprocessor List {listVersion}
subprocessor_notice.intro: We will change our Subprocessor List on {effectiveOn, date, long}, at least 30 days from this notice.
subprocessor_notice.objection: A customer may object under Section 7.3 of the Data Processing Agreement.

sms.help: XOS notifications: updates about your work from the organizations you belong to. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Help: {helpContact}. Reply STOP to opt out.
sms.stop: You will get no more texts from XOS notifications. Reply START to subscribe again.
sms.start: You will get XOS notifications by text again. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to opt out.
sms.summary: {orgName}: {count, plural, one {# update} other {# updates}} came in during your quiet hours. Most important: {body} {url} Reply STOP to opt out.
sms.summaryCount: {orgName}: {count, plural, one {# update} other {# updates}} came in during your quiet hours. Open your Inbox to read them: {url} Reply STOP to opt out.

deletionCertificate.subject: Deletion certificate for {org}
deletionCertificate.body:
The data of {org} was deleted from XOS on {date}, as the organization's lifecycle set out.

Your deletion certificate is attached. Its id is {id}. You can also download it from Atlas while you have an account.

Encrypted backups made before the deletion age out on their own schedule.
